result.summary: Clearfirth Glazing has sent invoice NBL-013-INV-09, but it shows no amount, and nothing on file confirms a visit or the fitting. The last update (event 021) was that the glass was delayed. I'm holding the invoice rather than forwarding it. I asked the contractor for the amount with a VAT breakdown and the fitting date, asked the tenant whether the pane was fitted and the problem has stopped, and told the landlord. The ticket is on hold with a 3-day follow-up.
result.situation: Tenant reported misted double glazing in the kitchen, with water at the frame and cold and damp concerns (event 001). Landlord agreed to Clearfirth if £180 was the total (event 010). The quote was £150 + VAT = £180 (events 009/011) and the agency recorded it as approved (event 012). Glass was ordered but delayed, with no appointment ever made (events 018, 021). On 9 September the case was moved to awaiting post-visit documents without any visit evidence (event 022). An invoice with no amount was uploaded on 10 September (event 023).

actions_taken.result: Stage is intake. The CRM has no approval record, no holds and no profile facts.
Ref NBL-013-INV-09, dated 10 Sep 2025, correct property, 'Supply and fit 1 pane of glass to the kitchen glazing'. Amount blank; no VAT, work date or billed-to party.

actions_taken.description: Looked for team lessons on invoice problems
Searched the case for 'fitted' to find any completion evidence
Tried to move the stage forward to works to reflect the approved, ordered job
actions_taken.result: Refused: the CRM has no structured landlord approval on record

actions_taken.description: Emailed the contractor asking for the invoice amount with a net/VAT breakdown and the fitting date
Emailed the tenant asking whether the pane has been fitted and the misting, water and cold have stopped
Emailed the landlord that the invoice is on hold pending the amount and completion confirmation
Put the ticket on hold waiting for the contractor and tenant answers
Recorded on the landlord's profile his conditional approval: £180 total
Recorded that there are pets at the property
Recorded that the tenant wants to be present for visits
Recorded a reliability note on the contractor

approvals.status: granted (conditional on £180 total), from events 010/012; not recorded as a structured CRM approval

escalation.reason: The contractor and tenant can answer what is missing (amount and completion). Nothing on the invoice conflicts with the approval yet.
escalation.recommendation: Escalate if the contractor's amount is above £180, the tenant says the work hasn't been done, or there's still no reply after a second follow-up.

judgement.why_this_decision: An invoice can't be forwarded without an amount to check against the approved £180. The records also don't show that the work was done: event 021 says the glass hadn't arrived, and event 022 moved the case to awaiting post-visit documents without any visit evidence. The contractor (amount, date) and tenant (whether it was fitted) can answer both questions, so I asked them instead of escalating.

alternatives_considered.option: Forward the invoice to the landlord for payment
alternatives_considered.why_not: There is no amount to compare with the £180 cap and no evidence the work was done.
This is resolvable by asking the contractor and tenant. It isn't a real conflict yet.
Completion isn't verified, and the tenant's damp and cold concern hasn't been confirmed resolved.

checks_performed: Invoice issuer Clearfirth Glazing matches the contractor on the job
Invoice amount is blank, so it can't be checked against £180
Searched the case for completion evidence and found none
Approval condition: £150 + VAT = £180 total meets the landlord's condition (events 009–012)
Not a safety emergency: the sash opens and locks
assumptions: The landlord's approval in event 010 covers the £180 total quote that the agency recorded in event 012
The 'NBL-013' prefix on the invoice relates to this job

unverified: Whether the glass was fitted, and when
Whether the landlord replied separately to the confirmation request in event 011 (only the agency note in event 012 is visible)
Whether the misting, water and cold problem is resolved, and whether there's wider damp
failures: move_stage to works was refused because the CRM has no structured approval record. The stage stays at intake, behind the real position.
risks_or_red_flags: The invoice was issued with no amount and no visit on record
The stage was moved to awaiting post-visit documents without any evidence of a visit (event 022)
The tenant's damp and cold concern was never assessed (event 005)
The CRM stage is behind the case because the approval isn't recorded in structured form
result.final_status: On hold (hold 269) waiting for the contractor's invoice amount and fitting date and the tenant's confirmation. The stage is still intake.

next_follow_up.what: Chase Clearfirth for the amount and fitting date and check the tenant's reply. If the amount is £180 or less and the work is confirmed, forward the invoice to the landlord and move to close-out. Otherwise escalate.
